claims.claim: 含服硝酸甘油后疼痛缓解作为心源性胸痛的诊断试验（270 例，4 周随访，随访率 95%），敏感度 72%（64%–80%）、特异度 37%（34%–41%）、阳性似然比 1.1（0.96–1.34）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: 270 patients were enrolled. Nitroglycerin relieved chest pain in 66% of the subjects. … The diagnostic sensitivity of nitroglycerin to determine cardiac chest pain was 72% (64%–80%), and the specificity was 37% (34%–41%). The positive likelihood ratio for having coronary artery … if nitroglycerin relieved chest pain was 1.1 (0.96–1.34). … Telephone follow-up at 4 weeks was performed, with a 95% follow-up rate.
claims.applicability: 加拿大大学医院急诊科前瞻队列（270 例），诊断标准含肌钙蛋白、心电图、造影或负荷试验；直接检验本题诊断效能问题，但人群为急诊就诊患者而非院外自救者，对中国院外场景为间接适用。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心；就诊前硝酸甘油使用未记录；诊断定义部分依赖主观判断（Shry 研究 12% 依赖心脏病专家主观印象）；研究完成于 2002–2006 年间。

claims.claim: 研究中 66% 的胸痛患者含服硝酸甘油后疼痛缓解。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: Nitroglycerin relieved chest pain in 66% of the subjects.
claims.applicability: 急诊场景；说明缓解率本身很高，不能作为病因线索。
claims.uncertainty: 疼痛缓解定义为疼痛评分下降 3 分以上或完全缓解（先验设定），不同定义会改变该比例。

claims.claim: 35 例急性心肌梗死（肌钙蛋白阳性）患者中 20 例含服硝酸甘油后缓解、15 例未缓解。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: There were 35 AMIs, based on troponin levels in the study population. Of those diagnosed with AMI, 20 experienced relief with NTG and 15 did not
claims.applicability: 直接反驳“心梗者含服必缓解”的经验推断；心肌梗死患者中相当比例含服后不缓解。
claims.uncertainty: 肌钙蛋白 T 阈值 0.3 mcg/L，与当代高敏肌钙蛋白标准不同。

claims.claim: 硝酸甘油缓解与否在区分冠心病与非冠心病胸痛上差异无统计学意义（p=0.12）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: Using a Pearson χ2, NTG was found not to be statistically significant (p = 0.12)
claims.applicability: 诊断效能结论的核心统计证据。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心、样本量 270 例。

claims.claim: 含服硝酸甘油后疼痛缓解不是可靠的诊断试验，不能区分心源性与非心源性胸痛。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: Relief of chest pain with nitroglycerin is not a reliable diagnostic test and does not distinguish between cardiac and non-cardiac chest pain.
claims.applicability: 本题核心结论之一；与 2021 年 AHA/ACC 指南表述一致。
claims.uncertainty: 研究对象为急诊可量化疼痛、完成心脏检查的住院患者，未包括急诊直接出院者（敏感性/特异性影响约 1%–2%，原文已述）。

claims.claim: 阳性似然比接近 1，提示含服缓解对冠心病的检验后概率与检验前概率相当。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: The positive likelihood ratio was approximately 1, suggesting that the pretest probability of disease was equivalent to the post-test probability of disease.
claims.applicability: 似然比≈1 的定量含义：缓解结果不改变病因概率估计。
claims.uncertainty: 基于单中心数据的点估计与区间（0.96–1.34）。

claims.claim: 2021 年 AHA/ACC 等学会胸痛指南建议不以硝酸甘油缓解疼痛作为诊断因素（其他病因如食管痉挛也可被硝酸甘油缓解）。
claims.sourceTitle: Nitroglycerin Use in the Emergency Department: Current Perspectives
claims.supportQuote: recent chest pain guidelines suggest that the relief of chest pain by NTG should not be used as a diagnostic factor (as other etiologies of chest pain such as esophageal spasm may be relieved by NTG)
claims.applicability: 指南层面表述（原文为综述转述 2021 年 AHA/ACC/ASE/CHEST/SAEM/SCCT/SCMR 指南）；支持“缓解不能作为鉴别依据”的实践结论。
claims.uncertainty: 指南原文全文未直接获取，经同行评议综述转述。

claims.claim: 2020 年 ESC 指南对存在持续缺血症状的患者舌下或静脉使用硝酸盐为 I 类、C 级推荐。
claims.sourceTitle: Nitroglycerin Use in the Emergency Department: Current Perspectives
claims.supportQuote: the 2020 European Society of Cardiology recommends (Class I, Level C) the use of sublingual or IV nitrates in patients with ongoing ischemic symptoms
claims.applicability: 指南推荐所针对的是“已判定为缺血”的医疗场景，不构成对未分化胸痛自行用药的推荐。
claims.uncertainty: C 级证据；舌下剂型的支持证据多由静脉硝酸盐研究外推而来（原文已述）。

claims.claim: 硝酸甘油推荐含服剂量为舌下或喷雾 0.3 至 0.6 mg，每 5 分钟重复给药，最多 3 次。
claims.sourceTitle: Nitroglycerin Use in the Emergency Department: Current Perspectives
claims.supportQuote: the recommended doses of NTG include sublingual or spray (0.3 to 0.6 mg) every 5 minutes up to a maximum of 3 doses
claims.applicability: 临床实践要点的给药方案依据；与中国说明书舌下含服用法一致。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述的通用推荐；个体剂量应遵循处方与说明书中“能有效缓解的最小剂量”原则。

claims.claim: 青岛（胶东半岛）汉族非冠心病组 356 例中 ALDH2 rs671 基因型为 GG 196 例（55.1%）、GA 130 例（36.5%）、AA 30 例（8.4%），G/A 等位基因频率 82.8%–17.2%。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
claims.supportQuote: Of the 356 cases in the NCHD group, 196 (55.1%) were of the GG genotype and 130 (36.5%) were of the GA genotype. Of the 130 cases, 30 (8.4%) accounted for the AA genotype with the G and A allele frequencies at 82.8%–17.2%, respectively.
claims.applicability: 中国北方汉族人群基因型与等位基因频率的直接测量数据，用于“携带率”相关表述。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心（青岛大学附属医院）；HWE 检验通过（原文报告 χ2=1.59，P>0.05），组间基因型分布差异无统计学意义。

claims.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
claims.supportQuote: Of the 203 cases in the CHD group, 103 (50.7%) were of the GG genotype and 86 (42.4%) were of the GA genotypes. Of the 86, 14 cases (6.9%) accounted for the AA genotype with the G and A allele frequencies of 81.4%–18.6%, respectively.
claims.applicability: 冠心病患者群体的携带率数据，为“约半数中国人为携带者”提供直接测量值。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心；冠心病诊断依据 ESC 2013 标准。

claims.claim: ALDH2 GA 型（杂合突变）仅保留约 6% 的酶活性，AA 型（纯合突变）丧失全部活性。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
claims.supportQuote: The GA genotype (i.e., mutant) only has 6% activity, whereas the AA genotype (i.e., mutant) loses all its activities.
claims.applicability: 酶学表型的量化描述（转述既往文献）；与综述中“杂合 6%、纯合近零”一致。
claims.uncertainty: 为原文转述的文献数据，酶活性百分比在不同测定体系间略有差异。

claims.claim: 冠心病组中含服硝酸甘油的缓解率：GG 型 79.4%、GA/AA 型 50.6%（P<0.01）。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
claims.supportQuote: The NTG efficacies of the GG and the GA/AA subgroups were 79.4% and 50.6%, respectively. The difference in rapid NTG efficiency was statistically significant ( P < 0.01)
claims.applicability: 中国汉族人群含服硝酸甘油缓解率按基因型分层的直接测量；携带者有效率仍约半数。
claims.uncertainty: 缓解率以主诉（含服后疼痛缓解）判定，无安慰剂对照、未设盲；样本来自单中心。

claims.claim: 含服硝酸甘油后野生型（GG）受试者心输出量增加、突变型（GA/AA）心输出量下降，提示基因型影响血流动力学反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
claims.supportQuote: All CO values in the wild-type case of both NCHD and CHD groups increased, whereas those in the mutant type decreased.
claims.applicability: 以客观血流动力学参数（无创阻抗法 CO、SVR）替代主诉终点，方向与主诉缓解率一致。
claims.uncertainty: 阻抗法间接测量；CHD 与 NCHD 两组均观察到同一方向，但个体间变异大。

claims.claim: 东亚人群 ALDH2 rs671 突变率最高可达 30%–50%。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
claims.supportQuote: The single nucleotide polymorphism mutation rate in East Asia reaches up to 30%–50%.
claims.applicability: 人群频率的常用表述（转述 Li H 等 2009 综述数据）。
claims.uncertainty: 转述性数据；“突变率”指携带者比例的上限估计。

claims.claim: 东亚人群中约 40% 存在与 ALDH2 活性下降相关的酒精耐受降低（面红）。
claims.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
claims.supportQuote: Lowered alcohol tolerance due to the accumulation of acetaldehyde is seen in around 40% of the East Asian population.
claims.applicability: “约四成东亚人群携带变异”的综述级量化表述。
claims.uncertainty: 综述估计值；不同人群亚群间变异大。

claims.claim: ALDH2 酶活性表型：Glu504 纯合子（*1/*1）活性完全正常，Lys504 纯合子（*2/*2）活性降至可忽略水平，Glu/Lys 杂合子仅约 6% 正常活性。
claims.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
claims.supportQuote: While Glu504 homozygotes (ALDH2*1/1) have fully functional enzymatic activity, a drop to negligible levels is seen in Lys504 homozygotes (ALDH2*2/2) and only an uptick to 6% of normal activity is seen in Glu504/Lys504 heterozygotes (ALDH2*1/2)
claims.applicability: 酶学表型的独立综述级确认，与中文队列转述（GA 6%、AA 缺失）一致。
claims.uncertainty: 体外/组织水平活性测定；体内净效应受其他代谢途径影响。

claims.claim: 142 例冠心病患者中含服硝酸甘油 5 分钟内缓解率：饮酒后面红者 20.4%，非面红者 67.1%；基因型层面 Glu504 患者 57.5%、Lys504 患者 11.1%。
claims.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
claims.supportQuote: recruited 142 coronary heart disease patients and showed that the amelioration of angina pectoris attacks within 5 min of GTN treatment was seen in 67.1% of patients who did not show flushing after drinking wine, compared to just 20.4% in flushing patients. This was consistent with genotype work, which showed that an efficacious response to GTN in 5 min was seen in 57.5% of Glu504 patients compared to 11.1% in the alcohol intolerant, Lys504 patients
claims.applicability: 以饮酒面红为表型标记的缓解率差异（转述 Zhang 等 2007 中文研究），提示表型-基因型的临床关联。
claims.uncertainty: 经综述转述；原始研究为 2007 年中文文献，方法学细节未核验。

claims.claim: ALDH2 Lys504 变异酶对硝酸甘油（GTN）的代谢效率下降约 10 倍，与含服疗效缺失相关。
claims.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
claims.supportQuote: for mutant subjects there was a lack of GTN efficacy, which was reinforced by enzyme kinetic studies that showed a 10-fold drop in GTN metabolism when using the Lys504 enzyme in place of the ALDH2 wild type
claims.applicability: 机制与酶动力学层面对“变异降低但不消除疗效”的支持（转述 Li 等 2006 的结论）。
claims.uncertainty: 经综述转述；JCI 2006 原文全文在本分析中未能获取，仅摘要层面核验。

claims.claim: 日本研究（2017）对三种 ALDH2 基因型受试者直接测量舌下硝酸甘油片的血管扩张反应，未发现基因型间差异。
claims.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
claims.supportQuote: concluded that Lys504 mutant subjects, when administered with GTN sublingually, showed no difference in terms of vasodilatory effects when compared to Glu504 wild type subjects
claims.applicability: 与阳性结果构成矛盾证据，用于界定效应量级的不确定性；提示存在 ALDH2 之外的生物活化途径。
claims.uncertainty: 经综述转述；原始研究（Miura 等 2017，Chem Biol Interact）为日本人群、以血管扩张为终点，与中国主诉缓解率终点不可直接比较。

claims.claim: Mackenzie 等（2005）显示突变携带者前臂血流反应较野生型低约 40%，并估计硝酸甘油总生物活化中不足一半依赖 ALDH2。
claims.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
claims.supportQuote: enhancements in forearm blood flow, using intra-arterial administration of GTN, but such improvements were still shown to be 40% lower in mutant subjects … which led Mackenzie and co-workers to conclude that while important, under half of GTN’s total bioactivation was ALDH2 dependent
claims.applicability: 界定基因型效应的上限：即使效应存在，ALDH2 依赖的活化不足一半，变异对总体疗效的影响被其他途径部分代偿。
claims.uncertainty: 经综述转述；动脉内给药而非舌下含服。

claims.claim: STEMI 患者 EMS 延误每增加 30 分钟，30 天死亡风险升高（校正 OR 1.20，95%CI 1.02 至 1.40）；该注册队列共 2976 例经 EMS 的 STEMI 患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Impact of emergency medical service delays on time to reperfusion and mortality in STEMI
claims.supportQuote: EMS delay time was independently associated with a higher risk of mortality (adjusted OR 1.20; 95% CI 1.02 to 1.40, for every 30 min increase) … Over the study period, a total of 2976 patients with STEMI presented to Ambulance Victoria and underwent PPCI at an interventional hospital.
claims.applicability: 澳大利亚州级注册研究（2976 例经 EMS 的 STEMI），直接支持“呼救环节延误增加死亡风险”。
claims.uncertainty: 观察性设计；关联主要见于合并心源性休克或院外心搏骤停者（无并发症者 aOR 0.95，95%CI 0.67–1.35）。

claims.claim: EMS 延误中位 59 分钟（IQR 48–77），占从呼救到再灌注总系统延误的前半。
claims.sourceTitle: Impact of emergency medical service delays on time to reperfusion and mortality in STEMI
claims.supportQuote: EMS delay time accounted for the first half of total system delay (median=59 min (IQR=48–77))
claims.applicability: 量化呼救-到达医院环节的时间占比，说明院外环节在总缺血时间中的权重。
claims.uncertainty: 单一州 EMS 体系；不同地区转运时间差异大。

claims.claim: 急诊再灌注（door-to-balloon）时间从 30 分钟延长至 150 分钟时，校正院内死亡率从 3.0% 依次升至 3.5%、4.3%、7.0%。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: adjusted in-hospital mortality rises progressively: from 3.0% at 30 min to 3.5% at 60 min, 4.3% at 90 min, and 7.0% at 150 min
claims.applicability: 再灌注延迟-死亡率的连续定量关系（综述转述的 landmark 分析），支撑“时间即心肌”。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述的既往分析数据；针对个体患者的最佳再灌注策略受多种因素影响。

claims.claim: 每 30 分钟再灌注延迟使死亡风险增加 7.5%。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: each 30 min reperfusion delay increases one-year mortality risk by 7.5%
claims.applicability: 延迟-远期死亡风险的量化。
claims.uncertainty: 综述转述；估计值来自既往研究汇总。

claims.claim: 症状出现到首次医疗接触的中位患者决策延迟约 100 分钟，占院前延迟约 60%。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: Median patient decision delay approximates 100 min, constituting nearly 60% of pre-hospital delay
claims.applicability: 院前延迟以患者决策环节为主——这是健康教育（含自救用药教育）可干预的主要环节。
claims.uncertainty: 综述级中位值；各国各人群变异大。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸治疗冠心病的 Meta 分析纳入 41 项随机对照试验、共 6276 例患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease.
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸随机对照证据体的规模与范围界定。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入试验均来自中国，多数为小样本单中心研究。

claims.claim: 该 Meta 分析纳入的试验全部在中国境内完成。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: All of the included studies were conducted in China.
claims.applicability: 证据的地域来源；对中国人群直接、对境外人群间接。
claims.uncertainty: 单一国家来源可能放大发表偏倚（原文 Egger 检验 P=0.067）。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸改善心电图结果优于其他治疗（RR 1.32，95%CI 1.26 至 1.38）；亚组中与硝酸甘油比较 RR 1.35（95%CI 1.16 至 1.56）、与消心痛比较 RR 1.14（95%CI 1.05 至 1.22）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Pooled analysis indicated significant benefits of suxiao jiuxin pill on ECG outcomes (RR 1.32; 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, P < 0.001). … The subgroup analyses indicated that suxiao jiuxin pill improved ECG results more than salvia tablets (RR 1.54; 95% CI 1.41 to 1.67, P < 0.001), isosorbide dinitrate (RR 1.14; 95% CI 1.05 to 1.22, P = 0.001), nitroglycerin (RR 1.35, 95% CI 1.16 to 1.56, P < 0.001), and other drugs (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.21 to 1.44, P < 0.001).
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸与硝酸酯类对照的唯一 Meta 分析级量化数据；需注意对照组为硝酸甘油“多种剂型”且场景为慢性冠心病管理。
claims.uncertainty: 心电图属替代终点；亚组间存在中等异质性（原文本组 I2=39.1%，其余亚组 I2 50.0%/44.9%/43.6%）；未纳入死亡等硬终点。

claims.claim: 多数纳入研究 Jadad 评分低，主要因缺乏双盲设计。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.applicability: 偏倚风险评定依据（AMSTAR 2 语境下的原始研究质量），支撑“证据确定性低”的 GRADE 判定。
claims.uncertainty: Jadad 量表为原始研究质量工具，作者亦自述“大多数研究质量差”。

claims.claim: 速效救心丸组与对照组不良事件率差异无统计学意义（RR 1.12，95%CI 0.50 至 2.51）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.applicability: 速效救心丸短期安全性的汇总数据；不良反应多为轻度头痛、头晕、面部潮红（原文）。
claims.uncertainty: 14 项研究报告不良事件；NMPA 说明书监测数据另记载恶心、呕吐、皮疹、过敏样反应等，发生率未知。

claims.claim: 该 Meta 分析的主要结局是心电图改善（静息心电图恢复正常或次极量运动试验转阴），未分析心血管死亡等硬终点。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcome of the selected studies was the improvement in ECG results, including resting ECG returning to normal or negative submaximal exercise test.
claims.applicability: 明确速效救心丸现有证据以替代终点为主，不构成对硬终点（死亡、心梗）获益的证据。
claims.uncertainty: 替代终点与临床结局的相关性未经该证据体验证。

claims.claim: 该 Meta 分析未分析心血管死亡或药物相关并发症，现有速效救心丸证据不覆盖死亡等硬终点。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.
claims.applicability: 界定证据边界：速效救心丸的随机对照证据无法回答急性胸痛自救场景下的结局问题。
claims.uncertainty: 作者自述；缺硬终点使疗效结论按 GRADE 为低确定性。

claims.claim: NHS 官方公众指导：突发且不缓解的胸部疼痛（可为压榨样或灼烧样）应立即呼叫急救（英国 999），需要即刻住院治疗；中国读者对应拨打 120。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain - NHS
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 公众层面的急救启动边界；中国读者按本国急救号码（120）执行，命题忠实于来源（中国急救号码见临床实践要点第 1 条）。
claims.uncertainty: 官方页面最后审阅日期 2023-08-08；页面针对英国公众；急救号码 120 为中国本地化对应，来源引文仅记载英国号码 999，120 未见于引文。

claims.claim: 含服硝酸甘油后疼痛缓解与否不能用于判断胸痛是否心源性，也不能作为不呼救或推迟就医的理由。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
supportingSources.supportQuote: Relief of chest pain with nitroglycerin is not a reliable diagnostic test and does not distinguish between cardiac and non-cardiac chest pain.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Nitroglycerin Use in the Emergency Department: Current Perspectives
supportingSources.supportQuote: recent chest pain guidelines suggest that the relief of chest pain by NTG should not be used as a diagnostic factor (as other etiologies of chest pain such as esophageal spasm may be relieved by NTG)

claims.applicability: 诊断学结论与指南表述在两条独立证据线上收敛；构成实践要点中“不得以缓解为由推迟呼救”的依据。
claims.uncertainty: 诊断效能数据来自北美急诊人群；指南表述经综述转述。

claims.claim: 按处方含服硝酸甘油后，若疼痛在 5 分钟间隔内未缓解（最多重复 3 次）或持续加重，应立即呼叫急救并接受急诊评估。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Nitroglycerin Use in the Emergency Department: Current Perspectives
supportingSources.supportQuote: the recommended doses of NTG include sublingual or spray (0.3 to 0.6 mg) every 5 minutes up to a maximum of 3 doses
You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.

claims.applicability: 由给药方案（每 5 分钟一次、最多 3 次）与“疼痛不缓解应呼叫急救”的公众指导综合而成；用于实践要点的呼救衔接。
claims.uncertainty: “5 分钟/3 次”为综述转述的通用推荐，具体间隔应以处方与说明书为准；合成结论不含对未处方硝酸甘油者的自行用药建议。

claims.claim: 按青岛汉族队列的基因型构成与各基因型含服缓解率推算，人群按主诉定义的硝酸甘油“无效”比例约为三分之一（约 34%–35%），而非“半数”；“约半数”实际对应携带 ALDH2*2 变异等位基因者的人群比例，将携带状态等同于无效过度估计了疗效缺失。
claims.assumptions: 青岛（胶东半岛）队列的基因型频率与各基因型缓解率可代表中国北方汉族人群；缓解率以含服后主诉缓解判定且与冠心病队列数值一致；单次给药、无安慰剂对照场景下观察到的缓解率近似真实反应率。
claims.applicability: 用于在结果与讨论中核查“硝酸甘油对约半数中国人无效”说法的量级：区分“携带率”（人群遗传学事实，约 45%–49%）与“无效率”（按主诉定义，约三分之一），并提示携带者内部仍有约半数（50.6%）可缓解。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心、观察性、主诉终点、无盲法；对“无效”的定义（含服后疼痛未缓解）敏感；不适用于个体水平的基因型检测建议——本文不推荐据此拒绝含服硝酸甘油。

claims.claim: 排除心源性胸痛（急性冠脉综合征）的依据是客观检查——心电图新发缺血改变、心肌肌钙蛋白升高、冠脉造影或负荷试验阳性——而非含服硝酸甘油后的反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in emergency department patients: if the pain is relieved by nitroglycerin, is it more likely to be cardiac chest pain?
claims.supportQuote: Cardiac chest pain — defined for this study as chest pain associated with 1 of the following: 1) new ECG changes of 1 mm in 2 contiguous leads, 2) positive cardiac troponin T >0.3 mcg/L (normal level <0.3 mcg/L)
claims.applicability: 本研究对“心源性胸痛”的参考标准定义，即排除 ACS 所依赖的客观证据类别；用于实践要点中“缓解不能替代客观评估”的表述。
claims.uncertainty: 肌钙蛋白 T 阈值 0.3 mcg/L 为研究时代标准，当代高敏肌钙蛋白的界值与动态变化判读不同，但“以客观检查为金标准”的原则不变。

claims.claim: 青岛汉族队列携带 ALDH2 rs671 A 等位基因（GA+AA 合计）者：非冠心病组 44.9%、冠心病组 49.3%，即约 45% 至 49%。
claims.method: 携带者比例 = GA 型比例 + AA 型比例：非冠心病组 36.5% + 8.4% = 44.9%；冠心病组 42.4% + 6.9% = 49.3%。交叉核对：原文直接报告 A 等位基因频率为 17.2%（非冠心病组）与 18.6%（冠心病组）；需说明原文基因型计数按公式 f(A)=(2×AA+GA)/(2×N) 换算约得 26.7%（非冠心病组，190/712），与原文报告的 17.2% 存在出入。本推导的携带率只取决于基因型计数加和，不依赖该等位基因频率的取舍。
claims.assumptions: 基因型分布符合哈迪-温伯格平衡（原文检验通过，χ2=1.59、0.49，P>0.05）；队列可代表中国北方汉族人群；携带率按 GA 与 AA 相加计算。
claims.sensitivity: 若基因型比例在亚组间波动 ±2 个百分点，携带率约在 43%–51% 之间变动；按东亚文献报告的携带率范围（30%–50%），本推导落在其中段。
claims.applicability: 为“约半数中国人携带 ALDH2*2 变异”提供直接测量来源的量化表述，用于区分携带率与含服无效率。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心队列；携带率是基因型计数的线性加和，不涉及回归估计，误差主要来自抽样；原文直接报告的等位基因频率（17.2%/18.6%）作为交叉核对。

claims.claim: 综合现有人群数据，ALDH2 rs671 变异对硝酸甘油反应的影响方向为降低而非消除：中国队列中携带者（GA/AA）含服缓解率 50.6% 低于野生型（GG）79.4%，但日本研究未观察到舌下硝酸甘油血管扩张的基因型差异，提示效应量级中等且存在人群与环境变异。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Effect of Aldehyde Dehydrogenase 2 Gene Polymorphism on Hemodynamics After Nitroglycerin Intervention in Northern Chinese Han Population
supportingSources.supportQuote: The NTG efficacies of the GG and the GA/AA subgroups were 79.4% and 50.6%, respectively.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Glyceryl Trinitrate: History, Mystery, and Alcohol Intolerance
supportingSources.supportQuote: concluded that Lys504 mutant subjects, when administered with GTN sublingually, showed no difference in terms of vasodilatory effects when compared to Glu504 wild type subjects

claims.applicability: 将中国阳性队列与日本阴性研究的差异整合为“降低而非消除”的结论表述，界定 ALDH2 效应量级的人群不确定性。
claims.uncertainty: 两条证据线的终点不同（主诉缓解率对血管扩张）、人群不同（汉族对日本人），不能直接合并为统一效应量；需中国人群盲法、安慰剂对照研究确证。
